reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It deals specifically with the acquisition of land parcels, compensation deposits for land acquisition, and detailed descriptions of land properties including names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and boundaries. This fits precisely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, land acquisitions, property ownership matters, and other land-related administrative procedures.
